title: RFC 6120 Stanza & Stream Errors and RFC 6121 Roster Subscriptions
solutionExplanation: Implements RFC 6120 structured error classification and RFC 6121 presence subscription state machines.

otpDocCards.description: Maps RFC 6120 error condition atoms to type and element name binaries.

mentalModelCheck.question: According to RFC 6120 Section 8, which error type must accompany the <not-authorized/> condition when a client attempts a command without logging in?

options.label: auth (prerequisite authentication or authorization failed)
options.explanation: RFC 6120 Section 8.3 defines auth as the formal error type for not-authorized and forbidden conditions.

options.label: cancel (the request cannot be retried under any circumstances)
options.explanation: cancel is reserved for fatal errors like item-not-found or service-unavailable.

options.label: modify (the request syntax is invalid)
options.explanation: modify is used for bad-request or invalid XML parameters.

options.label: wait (the server is temporarily overloaded)
options.explanation: wait is used for rate limits and resource-constraint.
